answer: As of May 20, 2026 Smucker's latest reported quarter was fiscal Q3 2026 (three months ended January 31, 2026): adjusted EPS of USD 2.38 (down 9% from USD 2.61), while GAAP diluted EPS was a loss of USD 6.79 on noncash impairment charges [H04-E1]. Fiscal 2026 guidance in effect (updated February 26, 2026): net sales growth 3.5% to 4.0% (previously 3.5%-4.5%) and adjusted EPS USD 8.75-9.25 (unchanged) [H04-E1]. output.answer:
## Answer

**Fiscal quarter:** Fiscal 2026 **third quarter** (quarter ended January 31, 2026), reported February 26, 2026 — the most recent quarter reported as of May 20, 2026.

- **Adjusted EPS: $2.38** per diluted share (down 9% year over year; GAAP net loss was $6.79 per share due to ~$961.7 million in noncash Sweet Baked Snacks/Hostess impairment charges). Net sales rose 7% to ~$2.34 billion.

**Fiscal 2026 net sales growth guidance in effect:** **3.5% to 4.0%** versus the prior year (lowered from the prior 3.5%–4.5% range, reflecting the estimated impact of the February 2026 fire at the Emporia, Kansas facility). Comparable net sales were expected to rise ~5.0%–5.5%.

For context, the same Q3 release **maintained** full-year adjusted EPS guidance of **$8.75–$9.25**, free cash flow of ~$975 million, and capex of $325 million.

### Sources
- The J.M. Smucker Co. – Fiscal 2026 Third Quarter Results (press release, Feb. 26, 2026): https://investors.jmsmucker.com/news/news-details/2026/The-J-M--Smucker-Co--Announces-Fiscal-2026-Third-Quarter-Results/default.aspx
- PR Newswire release: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/the-jm-smucker-co-announces-fiscal-2026-third-quarter-results-302698274.html
- FY26 Q3 Earnings Supplement (PDF): https://s203.q4cdn.com/703080298/files/doc_financials/2026/q3/The-J-M-Smucker-Co-FY26-Q3-Earnings-Supplement.pdf
- TradingView summary / 8-K reference: https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:0adef3cdd8350:0-j-m-smucker-co-reports-fiscal-2026-q3-results

*Note:* FY2026 full-year results (fiscal year ended April 30, 2026) were not yet reported as of May 20, 2026 — Smucker's Q4/full-year release typically comes in early June. (Sources referencing full-year adjusted EPS of $9.15 and FY2027 guidance reflect that later release.)
